title: clematis orientalis var. glauca
intro: Clematis orientalis var. glauca, commonly known as Oriental Clematis or Manchu Clematis, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family, known for its attractive, glaucous foliage and white or pale yellow flowers. The leaves and roots of this plant have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Clematis orientalis var. glauca include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain and inflammation, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
